title: Hissatsu Pachinko Collection (Japan, Rev A): pause check
summary: Use the upstream pause-status workaround from an SD sector recipe.
rationale: The first-read program has the guarded compare-immediate site used by SAROO's built-in patch. Its other revision site has different source bytes and is deliberately left alone.

writes.effect: Change the first-read program's CMP/EQ immediate at 0601085C from 1 to 0x56.
writes.reason: Retain the upstream workaround for a PAUSE-status loop without editing the original image.
